attempts.summary: Built a 3-member etcd v3.5.17 cluster on node1/node2/node3 (CentOS Stream 10) using downloaded static binaries, systemd unit etcd.service, static bootstrap config in /etc/etcd/etcd.conf, and firewalld ports 2379/2380 opened on each node. Verified cross-member replication, verified reads/writes continue with one member down (stopped node3, wrote/read via node1/node2), verified node3 caught up automatically on restart. Then executed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all three nodes via systemctl reboot, confirming boot_id changes and post-restart etcd/cluster health and data integrity after each restart, preserving quorum throughout.
